title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.09.1
notes:
- Added customizable mouse and keyboard actions by context, with named actions, sequences and portable scripts in Settings > Controls.
- Organized Settings tabs and added collapsible Workspace Visibility groups, with independent visibility choices for Controls, Vocal Tuning, audio timing and clip preview buttons.
- Replaced the old Warp Markers dialog with an inline Playlist audio timing editor. Detect transients, edit anchors, select multiple points, quantize, zoom with Ctrl or Alt and apply with undo support.
- Added looping Play and Stop previews for audio clips and supported patterns in the Playlist clips picker, with a cleaner panel border.
- Improved Playlist and Piano Roll overviews and horizontal scrollbar handling. Added a choice of classic or separate Playlist scrollbar styles and theme-specific clip brightness.
- Refined Mixer scrolling with a compact grab handle and protected the area beneath send controls from accidental channel selection.
- Plugin discovery now runs when requested. Startup preserves the Channel Rack visibility preference and skips clean import reports.
- Reduced unnecessary Mixer audio work and separated display updates from audio buffering to improve playback under load.
- Improved local vintage theme artwork loading from platform profile folders.

https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/
